# tplinkrouter_syslog_settings (Data Source)

Manage syslog settings. Destroy releases management without resetting the device.

## 范围与行为

- 分类：system。
- SLP 读取对象：`system.syslog`。
- 管理页面证据：`/userrpm/system_log.htm`。
- 只读查询，不修改运行配置，也不执行保存。秘密写入字段不暴露为读取属性。

## 属性

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | 只读 | 否 | 此读取结果的稳定标识。 |
| `level` | `string` | 只读 | 否 | Router level setting. |
| `module` | `string` | 只读 | 否 | Router module setting. |
| `send_server` | `string` | 只读 | 否 | Router send server setting. |
| `level_switch` | `bool` | 只读 | 否 | Router level switch setting. |
| `module_switch` | `bool` | 只读 | 否 | Router module switch setting. |
| `log_send` | `bool` | 只读 | 否 | Router log send setting. |
